Each figure: native crop image, closed part list, declared-absent controls, glossary handed verbatim to the TRANSCRIBE burst. The question set + strict schema are generated by transcribe.questions.parts_questions / parts_schema (T0-d2) from parts + controls; answers are scored by compare/calibrate_transcriber.py against hand_inventory.json.
glossary_F04: hair = the hair mass on the head · face = the visible face · shirt = the under-garment with sleeves (or a visible under-layer at collar/sleeves) · tabard = the sleeveless over-garment with hanging panels · belt = a WAIST belt (one belt with several buckles is 1) · satchel = a bag or pouch hung from a belt or strap · harness_strap = a strap crossing the torso (NOT a waist belt; an X of two straps = 2) · pauldron_L / pauldron_R = a shoulder plate on the figure's LEFT / RIGHT shoulder (the figure faces you: its left shoulder is on YOUR right) · bracer_L / bracer_R = a forearm guard on the figure's LEFT / RIGHT forearm · trousers = the leg garment · boots = footwear (a pair = 2) · rod = a hand-held staff or rod · rod_head = a distinct head-piece on the rod · helmet = head armour · cape = a cloak or cape · shield = a shield · second_belt = a SECOND waist belt separate from the first
glossary_F03: hair · face · jacket = a hip-length outer garment · coat = a long (knee-length or longer) outer garment · shirt = an under-garment or visible under-layer · belt = a WAIST belt · harness_strap = a strap crossing the torso (rifle sling or chest band; NOT the waist belt) · pouch = a bag or pouch on belt or strap · tool = a hand tool carried on the person (wrench, pliers…) · trousers · boots (a pair = 2) · bracer = a forearm guard · knee_pad = a knee plate or pad · rifle = a long firearm · pauldron = a shoulder plate (either shoulder; count each) · helmet · cape · shield · staff = a hand-held staff or rod
